appDescription: Shares the current pickup agreement and manually reported pickup progress between a driver and a rider.

function.name: GET_PICKUP_STATUS
function.description: Reads the current pickup progress and rider readiness for the driver of the active pickup agreement.

function.name: REPORT_PICKUP_ARRIVAL
function.description: Records the driver's explicit report of arrival at the agreed pickup point when a rider has joined and no location change is pending.
